POLICY.TITLE: Privacy Policy
POLICY.SECTION_1_TEXT: The data controller for this website is {{name}}, {{address}}, {{city}}. Contact: {{email}}.
POLICY.SECTION_2_TEXT: When you visit this website, technically necessary data is automatically processed (e.g. IP address, date/time, requested page, referrer, browser and operating system). This processing is required to ensure security and stability of the website and is based on Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.
POLICY.SECTION_3_TEXT: If you use the contact form, I process the data you provide (name, email address, message) in order to handle your request. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (pre-contractual communication) and, where applicable, Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.
POLICY.SECTION_4_TEXT: Personal data is stored only for as long as necessary for the stated purposes. Afterwards, data is deleted unless statutory retention obligations apply.
POLICY.SECTION_5_TEXT: Your data is shared with third parties only if legally permitted or required. If external service providers are used for technical operation, this is done in compliance with applicable data protection law.
POLICY.SECTION_6_TEXT: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict processing, and transfer your data, as well as the right to object to processing. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority. For privacy-related requests, please contact {{email}}.
POLICY.SECTION_7_TEXT: This website uses appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data against loss, misuse, or unauthorized access. Data transmission is encrypted via HTTPS.
POLICY.SECTION_8_TEXT: Updated: February 18, 2026. I reserve the right to update this privacy policy due to legal, technical, or content-related changes.
